definitions.explanation: Informing the authorities or relevant parties about an incident, crime, or emergency. Often used in the context of calling the police or emergency services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通報|つうほう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I reported it to the police.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通報|つうほう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駆|か}けつけた→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: The police rushed to the scene after a tip from a neighbor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけたら→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通報|つうほう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you see a suspicious person, please report it immediately.

notes:
Most commonly used for reporting incidents to the police or emergency services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通報|つうほう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (report to the police)
- ⟦{消防|しょうぼう}→消防：03241_shoubou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通報|つうほう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (report to the fire department)
- ⟦{匿名|とくめい}→匿名：11797_tokumei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{通報|つうほう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (report anonymously)
- {通報|つうほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (receive a report)
- {通報|つうほう}{者|しゃ} (the person who reported)

In Japan, 110 is the police emergency number and 119 is fire/ambulance. The phrase 110⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧{通報|つうほう} specifically means calling the police emergency line.
